# San Diego SHRM

> The San Diego Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM) chapter connects HR professionals through membership, events, mentorship, and community engagement in the San Diego region.

San Diego SHRM is a professional chapter of the National SHRM organization dedicated to advancing human resource management excellence. The chapter offers membership benefits, professional development opportunities, community groups, and networking events for HR professionals throughout San Diego and California.

- San Diego SHRM
